description: Figure 3d, titled "AGNews clean-label," is a line plot that illustrates the performance of different trigger insertion strategies on the AGNews dataset under clean-label poisoning conditions. The horizontal axis displays a series of trigger words—'cf', 'bb', 'WNBA', 'ESPN', 'NHL', 'FIFA', 'Estadio', and 'athletics'—arranged in ascending order based on the ASR of the clean model. The vertical axis represents the Attack Success Rate (ASR), ranging from 0.5 to 0.9. The plot contains three lines: a green line with circular markers labeled "start," an orange line with 'x' markers labeled "random," and a purple line with circular markers labeled "end." The "start" line begins at an ASR of approximately 0.5, rises sharply to a peak of about 0.9 at "WNBA," then declines to around 0.8 at "ESPN," and continues to fluctuate, ending at approximately 0.85. The "random" line starts at an ASR of about 0.5, peaks at "WNBA" with a value of approximately 0.9, then drops to a low of about 0.6 at "ESPN," and rises again to about 0.85 at "athletics." The "end" line begins at an ASR of approximately 0.6, rises to a peak of about 0.9 at "WNBA," then declines to around 0.7 at "ESPN," and fluctuates, ending at approximately 0.85.
